column1: # One merge commit per line: <full-sha> <TAB> <reason>. Comments and blank
# lines ignored. A waived commit is reported as `WAIVE`, counted apart from
# both `ok` and `shape`, and its reason is printed — a waiver that nobody
# reads is the same as no gate.
# Per commit, never per pattern. The gate exists because "every merge traces
# to a molecule" is nearly always true; the rare merge that genuinely is not a
# molecule harvest must cost someone a written sentence a reviewer sees in the
# diff, not a widened regex that silently forgives every future merge too.
# Same discipline as `publish: allow — <reason>`, which is per line and never
# per file for exactly this reason.

column2: One-time collapse of the two trunks (2026-07-30). `main` required linear history, so `cs done` merges could not land on it and a private `dev` line existed to receive them; when that requirement was dropped, the two lines were reunited by merging `origin/main` INTO `dev`. That direction made the dev line the first-parent spine and left the published trunk hanging off as a second parent, which is exactly what this gate refuses. The incoming side is 626e09b1e57c345f48a9894845e0b2177a6055b0 — `origin/main` itself at the time, so every line it carries was gated when it landed there. Nothing ungated entered through this merge; what changed is which side git calls the spine.

sync-merge of main INTO feat/task-20260731-9cf4, made by the M4 worker to integrate 16-commits-behind trunk before finishing (mission co-pilotage M4); it reached main inside the molecule harvest merge 075c32a. The molecule and ledger completion exist (task-20260731-9cf4); only the inner sync-merge subject is outside the documented form, and the branch is pushed so the subject cannot be amended.

sync-merge of origin/main into local main after PR #44 was squash-merged on GitHub. GitHub created dba1c987 on the remote; the local trunk carried 11 unpushed molecule merges, so a fast-forward was impossible. Not a molecule harvest: it reconciles the remote squash with local work already gated. The molecules it carries keep their own merge subjects above it.
